Title: PostgreSQL
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-7
Content: PostgreSQL is a relational database management system. The JDBC connector can connect to a PostgreSQL database to pull structure and lineage metadata. To leverage these capabilities, solidatus.jdbc.driver must be set to postgresql. For SQL parsing related features solidatus.jdbc.dialect must be set to postgresql.

Title: JDBC URL formatting
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/configuration/jdbc-url-formatting
Content: Typical connection string structure:

jdbc:postgresql://<host>:<port>/<database>?<properties>

Please see for more information: https://jdbc.postgresql.org/documentation/use/
